principle: retain personal or potentially linkable research data for the shortest period needed to validate the needs analysis; preserve longer-term evidence only as genuinely anonymised aggregate outputs and integrity hashes

provider_context.candidate_hosting_processor: CLAUS WEB SRL / shared-hosting family, subject to account-order verification
provider_context.public_dpa_note: Annex 4 subprocessor list and Annex 5 backup/retention values remain subject to account-specific operational validation before final adoption
provider_context.public_shared_hosting_backup_observation: current public product information indicates short-cycle backups for shared hosting, but the actual eucons.ro account/service policy must be verified before go-live
provider_context.control_consequence: live-store deletion deadlines do not by themselves prove physical disappearance from residual backups; provider backup rotation/restore controls must be documented and tested before collection

schedules.allowed_content: security/availability metadata only; request bodies, form answers and raw Idempotency-Key MUST NOT be logged
schedules.target_retention: 7 days maximum unless a documented security necessity requires a shorter period; any longer exception requires explicit controller approval and must not include questionnaire payloads
schedules.gate: hosting configuration and actual provider retention must be verified before collection

schedules.data_class: raw and normalised analytical respondent records in live research storage
schedules.retention: until needs-analysis validation and application evidence freeze, then delete from live/application-accessible storage no later than 180 days after primary collection closes
schedules.live_store_hard_stop: 2027-03-31 unless a documented legal claim/audit hold approved by the controller requires a narrower retained subset
schedules.backup_residual_rule: after live deletion, any residual provider backup copy may persist only through the validated pre-existing backup cycle; it must not be restored into live processing except for documented disaster recovery/legal necessity, and it must expire by provider rotation without creating a new retention cycle
schedules.post_deletion: retain only anonymised aggregates, disclosure-controlled tables, source/provenance metadata and cryptographic integrity hashes that cannot be used to reconstruct respondent records

schedules.content: opaque derived response_id + canonical body digest only; no raw key
schedules.retention: same live lifecycle as the corresponding analytical respondent record
schedules.deletion: delete atomically from live storage with respondent-level records; residual backup treatment follows the same validated provider cycle

schedules.content: opaque derived response_id plus technical expires_at_utc retention metadata only; no questionnaire answers, canonical body digest, raw Idempotency-Key, identity/contact data, IP, user-agent, device, CRM or employer identifier
schedules.purpose: prevent a delayed transport retry from recreating a respondent-level record after an approved live erasure
schedules.retention: maximum 24 hours from successful live erasure; a shorter live bound is permitted; any longer period is forbidden unless a documented security necessity and explicit controller approval are recorded before use
schedules.retention_rationale: the submission contract keeps the canonical UUIDv4 idempotency key only in same-tab/session retry state and forbids cookies, fingerprints, CRM identifiers or other persistent client identifiers; no offline/persistent submission queue is part of the reviewed design, so a 24-hour replay-suppression window is a conservative bounded transport-safety control rather than analytical retention
schedules.production_binding_control: the live rights-control adapter must assign a finite per-marker expires_at_utc not later than successful erasure + 24 hours and purge expired markers automatically before replay checks and by scheduled cleanup
schedules.reference_adapter_note: the current SQLite adapter is TEST/REFERENCE only and must not be treated as the PROD binding; provider-bound PROD smoke must prove the per-marker maximum-24-hour expiry behavior
schedules.export: FORBIDDEN from analytical export, NF06, source register and long-term need evidence
schedules.deletion: production adapter must delete each marker automatically no later than its finite expires_at_utc and include marker counts in deletion evidence
schedules.gate: collection remains NO_GO until the determined controller accepts this retention schedule, the live binding enforces the maximum-24-hour per-marker rule, and provider-bound TEST TWIN proves automatic expiry/deletion

schedules.retention: delete from live storage after the requested follow-up is completed and in all cases no later than 90 days after primary collection closes
schedules.post_deletion: no contact identifier is copied to NF06 or analysis evidence; any residual backup follows only the verified provider rotation

schedules.data_class: immutable primary export used for NF06 validation
schedules.retention: same live respondent-level hard stop as analytical records
schedules.control: encrypted/restricted evidence location; SHA-256 retained after export deletion; any backup residual is governed by the same verified non-renewing rotation

schedules.classification: NON_EVIDENCE / synthetic=true / no real personal data
schedules.separation: must never share PROD evidence namespace or promotion path

deletion_evidence_required: row/object counts before and after live deletion
documented account-specific backup schedule and maximum residual lifetime
confirmation that deleted respondent data cannot silently return to live processing through ordinary restore jobs
confirmation that a stale idempotent retry cannot recreate an erased respondent record during the bounded replay-suppression window
confirmation that each non-analytical erasure replay marker is automatically purged no later than 24 hours after successful live erasure
confirmation that backup rotation does not restart the retention clock for deleted research records
confirmation that optional contact store and PROD analytical store were both checked

exceptions.legal_hold: must be documented by controller with scope, reason, approver, start date and review date; blanket indefinite retention is forbidden
exceptions.replay_marker_extension: a period longer than 24 hours is forbidden by default and requires a documented security necessity plus explicit controller approval before the extension is used
exceptions.processor_backup_limit: Annex 5/account-specific backup terms and restore behavior must be validated before go-live; if provider cannot meet the intended non-renewing residual-backup lifecycle, collection remains NO_GO
